items.message: Watcher polls every 50 ms but never exits early after cancelling — it cancels tasks and returns, but the poll interval means kill-switch latency is 0–50 ms per check cycle, not the 50 ms worst case the comment implies.
JoinResult.cost sums in a Python loop, rebuilding a Cost object per branch — harmless at small fan-out counts but called repeatedly since it is a property with no caching.
